cost_policy: Conservative uncached, high-tier/peak-time upper estimates, not billed account totals. Fail closed if usage unknown or reservation bound is exceeded.
selection_note: Executor chose catalog-listed versions before new outputs. GLM-4.7 has current public pricing; legacy GLM-4.6 was not silently assumed to retain its previous price. Qwen snapshot pinned, DeepSeek endpoint is a serving alias; record returned models and dates.
statistical_policy: Item-weighted descriptive paired effects; cluster bootstrap intervals conditional on components; sign-flip p-values, if computed, exploratory/conditional only, not confirmatory. No verified sign-exchangeability or random population sampling claim.
